entry.title: Revisiting Avatar-As-Image: High-Fidelity Registration is All You Need

entry.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
entry.summary: We present Vidu S2, which comprises Vidu S2-Avatar, a real-time interactive digital-character model, and Vidu S2-Editing, a real-time video editing model. Moreover, we explore the feasibility of real-time spatial video generation for both Vidu S2-Avatar and Vidu S2-Editing.
